say:1:1631216001:1.text: You cost me a fortune that day... no, worse. You cost me the chance at a fortune.
say:1:1631216001:1.source_cn: 您可让我亏了一大笔……不，是错过了一大笔啊！
say:1:1631216001:1.male: You cost me a fortune that day... no, worse. You cost me the chance at a fortune.
say:1:1631216001:1.female: You cost me a fortune that day... no, worse. You cost me the chance at a fortune.

say:2:1631216002:1.text: If I'd known who you were, I'd have written your name at the very top of the betting board—etched in gold!
say:2:1631216002:1.source_cn: 我当初真是有眼无珠！早知道您是梅林，我肯定把您的名字写...
say:2:1631216002:1.male: If I'd known who you were, I'd have written your name at the very top of the betting board—etched in gold!
say:2:1631216002:1.female: If I'd known who you were, I'd have written your name at the very top of the betting board—etched in gold!

choice_prompt:3:1631216002.text: If I'd known who you were, I'd have written your name at the very top of the betting board—etched in gold!

say:4:1631216003:1.text: Just imagine! If everyone had bet on you, and Miss Cassadee still won... the shift in odds alone would've filled a vault!
say:4:1631216003:1.source_cn: 您想想，要是大家都押您赢，而最后胜出的却是科丝蒂小姐…...
say:4:1631216003:1.male: Just imagine! If everyone had bet on you, and Miss Cassadee still won... the shift in odds alone would've filled a vault!
say:4:1631216003:1.female: Just imagine! If everyone had bet on you, and Miss Cassadee still won... the shift in odds alone would've filled a vault!

say:5:1631216004:1.text: It might just be the greatest missed opportunity of my life... Ah, but what's done is done.
say:5:1631216004:1.source_cn: 可惜啊可惜，现在说什么都晚啦。这大概就是我人生中最大的...
say:5:1631216004:1.male: It might just be the greatest missed opportunity of my life... Ah, but what's done is done.
say:5:1631216004:1.female: It might just be the greatest missed opportunity of my life... Ah, but what's done is done.

say:6:1631216005:1.text: Perhaps next time... if there ever is one.
say:6:1631216005:1.source_cn: 下次……唉，但愿还有下次机会吧！
say:6:1631216005:1.male: Perhaps next time... if there ever is one.
say:6:1631216005:1.female: Perhaps next time... if there ever is one.
